verification_method: Find Case Law (caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk) direct fetch of a later citing judgment, per the citing-judgment method documented in docs/OPERATING_RULES.md. BAILII's own 1990 judgment text was not independently read this session.

authorities.name: Caparo Industries plc v Dickman
authorities.date_note: This date was stated by the verifying agent, but the verification method (citing-judgment, not the original text) doesn't independently re-confirm it - carried over as reported, not independently re-checked.
authorities.proposition: Duty of care in a novel situation requires (i) foreseeability of harm, (ii) a relationship of proximity, and (iii) that it be fair, just and reasonable to impose a duty (Lord Bridge's three-stage test).
authorities.verification_note: Not read directly - BAILII blocked (HTTP 403), block treated as final per docs/OPERATING_RULES.md. Citation and proposition confirmed via Robinson v Chief Constable of West Yorkshire Police [2018] UKSC 4 (below), which quotes it by full citation and discusses it at length.

authorities.name: Robinson v Chief Constable of West Yorkshire Police
authorities.date_note: Year only confirmed via the citation itself; exact date not independently verified this session.
authorities.proposition: The proposition that a single Caparo test applies to all negligence claims is mistaken - Caparo's three-stage test governs novel duty situations only; established categories of duty proceed by incremental analogy to precedent, not by re-running the three-stage test each time.

edges.verified_via: Robinson v CC West Yorkshire [2018] UKSC 4, para 21, fetched directly from Find Case Law: confirms Caparo as good law but clarifies its scope (novel-duty situations, not a universal formula).

what_this_is_not: One verified node-pair on the Caparo duty-of-care test's current scope, as clarified by the Supreme Court in 2018. Does not survey the many other duty-of-care category cases (established relationships that don't need the Caparo test at all), and does not independently confirm Caparo's original 1990 text - see verification_note above.
